about: I'm a software engineer building AI-powered products, backend systems, and full-stack applications. I've built production software across AI/LLMs, backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, mobile applications, and data systems: an AI-powered tender-management platform at Livelihood Impact Fund (100+ users, ~30% less manual data entry), SynapTrack clinical research software at Washington University, and the product and analytics stack at SendBack (10,000+ events, 24% better auth success). I studied Computer Science (B.S. & M.S.) at Washington University in St. Louis. I enjoy taking ambiguous problems from idea to deployment and building software that people actually use. I'm open to Software Engineering, AI Engineering, and Data Engineering opportunities.
